rounding_mode.title: Rounding
rounding_mode.description: Default rounding of the unit price when a configurator does not set its own: none, nearest, up or down to the increment.

rounding_increment.title: Rounding increment (minor units)
rounding_increment.description: For example 100 rounds to whole units of a two-decimal currency.

rounding_ending.title: Price ending (minor units, 0 = none)
rounding_ending.description: After rounding, end the price on this value below the increment — for example increment 100 and ending 99 turn 20.00 into 19.99.

show_breakdown.title: Return the price breakdown
show_breakdown.description: Include every delta (option, unit price, rule) in evaluation and quote results.
